India Promoted as Global Medical Tourism Destination

India is being promoted as a global health destination, aiming to attract international patients for medical treatments. The initiative, referred to as 'Heal in India', seeks to leverage the country's healthcare infrastructure and expertise. Efforts are underway to make medical travel to India more accessible, including guidance on utilizing global health insurance for treatments within the country. This push is part of a broader strategy to position India as a preferred location for medical tourism.
